Overview

A closer look

TokenShield™ is nTrust.ai’s enterprise AI Privacy & Security Web Application Firewall (WAF) and cryptographic token vault. Designed specifically for LLM applications and autonomous multi-agent pipelines, TokenShield sits directly between your applications and AI providers, inspecting and transforming prompts in microseconds.

Traditional redaction tools break model comprehension by replacing words with ugly placeholders like [REDACTED] or XXXXX. TokenShield introduces Context-Preserving Synthetic Surrogates—swapping sensitive entities with realistic, type-preserving fictional values that preserve syntax, grammatical context, and prompt reasoning integrity.

When the model issues authorized downstream tool calls (such as code execution, API invocations, or database queries), TokenShield’s Transparent Tool Rehydrator deterministically restores original plaintext in local sandbox memory, ensuring full task execution without cloud data exposure.

Capabilities

What you get

⚡

Dual-Engine Threat Detection

Combines lightning-fast regex & Aho-Corasick matching for high-entropy secrets (GitHub PATs, AWS credentials, JWTs) with Microsoft Presidio semantic NLP for contextual PII discovery.

🎭

Synthetic Entity Swapping

Replaces sensitive entities with realistic, context-preserving surrogates (e.g. valid-looking names, phone numbers, addresses) so model reasoning and code formatting remain intact.

🔄

Transparent Tool Rehydration

When agents trigger tool invocations (bash, SQL, git, APIs), TokenShield automatically detokenizes arguments back to original values in local RAM prior to execution.

🔐

Differential Privacy & Salt Rotation

Tokens are derived using epoch-salted HMAC hashes to prevent frequency analysis attacks. Scheduled salt rotation continuously invalidates historical correlation vectors.

🛡️

Firewall Candidate Commit Engine

Operate with enterprise 3-state controls (Disabled, Observe, Enforce). Test candidate rules in dry-run mode and commit updates atomically across your fleet with zero downtime.

🏢

Zero Cloud Visibility

All tokenization, vault storage, and rehydration happen strictly within your sovereign boundary. Third-party LLM providers only ever see sanitized synthetic payloads.
